scoring_justification: Result-level compare against paper-reported B3LYP/6-311+G(3df,2p) values; recompute from raw is infeasible because the intermediate energies.json is not a guaranteed scored artifact and may be missing or unstructured.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for B3LYP/6-311+G(3df,2p) computed gas-phase basicities and deprotonation Gibbs free energies for ethylarsine, vinylarsine, ethynylarsine.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 5, B3LYP/6-311+G(3df,2p) column, first row for each molecule (as-protonation and as-deprotonation): EA GB=190.1, Δ_acidG°=356.0; VA GB=186.6, Δ_acidG°=345.0; ETA GB=174.2, Δ_acidG°=338.8 (all kcal/mol).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact values the paper reports from its own B3LYP calculations; they serve as the authoritative reference that an independent re-running of the same functional/basis set should reproduce within a tolerance accounting for code differences.

outputs.description: Gas-phase basicities (GB) and acidities (Δ_acidG°) for ethylarsine (EA), vinylarsine (VA), and ethynylarsine (ETA), computed at B3LYP/6-311+G(3df,2p)//B3LYP/6-311G(d). Each row holds one computed value.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker will compare each of the six numeric values (three GB, three Δ_acidG°) to the corresponding B3LYP/6-311+G(3df,2p) results for As-protonated and As-deprotonated species reported in the source paper. The reward is the fraction of values matching within a predefined tolerance.

steps.description: Compare the six reported GB and Δ_acidG° values against the paper's B3LYP/6-311+G(3df,2p) results, with an absolute tolerance of 1.0 kcal/mol.
